text:
Avery: Quick design tradeoff for first-run surface: do we surface an immersive sample explorer (large panel with previews) or a compact checklist card that sits in the header? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/qwerty/first-run-explorer

Rohan: Compact card wins for speed-to-action. Users in playtests preferred not to be overwhelmed. But explorer had higher perceived value when they wanted inspiration.

Maya: Accessibility: explorer needs proper heading structure and image alt text for previews. If we lazy-load images, ensure `loading="lazy"` + meaningful `alt` so screen readers get context.

Sofia: Microcopy: top line "Get started: try a sample" vs "Finish setup". Avoid 'finish' language. Buttons: 'Open sample' or 'Deploy sample' depending on state. Small time estimate under title helps set expectations.

Avery: What about responsive behavior? Compact card on desktop header, explorer as a full-panel modal when users click "Browse samples". On mobile show the explorer directly after a prompt.

Rohan: Implementation note: store last-viewed preference per-account so returning users see the compact card if they dismissed explorer. API: POST /v1/settings {"onboard_view_preference":"compact|explorer"} (debounced).

Maya: A11y checklist: 1) ensure focus trap in modal explorer; 2) announce counts like "5 samples available" with `aria-live`; 3) avoid auto-play previews; 4) keyboard shortcuts: `g s` to open samples.

Sofia: Experimentation: record `first_run.variant=compact|explorer` and events `first_run.open`, `sample.preview`, `sample.deploy_start`, `first_run.dismiss`. Include `ui_entrypoint` context (home, projects, onboarding-flow).

Avery: UX detail: when someone deploys a sample, show an inline subtle celebration (checkmark + "You're live") rather than full confetti. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Rohan: Dev will add a feature flag `onboard.sample_explorer` and a small spike for modal accessibility this sprint.

DevPreviewBot: Staging: 0.46.7 contains explorer modal behind flag. QA: @Maya please run a quick screen reader pass.

Maya: Will do. I'll add a short a11y checklist to the Figma notes and link test cases.
